data.body: HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-12 06:00 PST: in_progress. Fix committed in .rebar/worktrees/fix-shark as ec59ea0f0cf, not pushed. The scheduling-dependent positive control is replaced by a deterministic one: a reference-transaction hook (active only in that fetch) moves refs/remotes/origin/tickets in the `preparing` state, so the real fetch fails with "is at X but expected Y" and is_ref_cas_mismatch must recognise it; with the hook made a no-op the control fails. The coordination half is its own test (0 mismatches over 8 rounds). Skips on git < 2.48; CI runners have git 2.55/2.56. Passed 5 of 5 at load average 42. Next: make verify, push, close after the Bedrock spend cap releases (16:00 PST).
